rationale.selected_because: The current record supports continuing the already arranged electrical response in Flat 2 while keeping the unresolved Flat 3 access issue separate. Bevin reports continued dripping and an apparently larger ceiling bulge, can meet the electrician, and reports no sparks, smoke, or fallen material. The electrical attendance window is stated to remain 12:30–13:15, but the supplied evidence does not establish that the electrician has attended or assessed the fitting. The plumber's Flat 2 and common-riser attendance did not identify the source or a usable isolation point. Yara continues to withhold consent to Flat 3 entry, Niko has not authorized entry, and no entry authority was confirmed. Accordingly, the proposed actions request an update and work report, provide safety guidance, seek the full agreement and a responsible review, and do not authorize Flat 3 entry or expanded work.

assumptions: The latest Flat 2 reports concern the same ongoing incident and wet fitting as the stated electrical attendance, based on their continuity and context.
alternatives_considered: No emergency-services contact is proposed because the latest report says Bevin has not seen sparks or smoke and no material has fallen; the prior safety instructions identify those signs or immediate danger as reasons to contact emergency services.
No entry into Flat 3, or provider instruction to enter, is proposed because consent remains withheld and entry authority is unconfirmed.
No completed electrical assessment or resolved leak is assumed; requesting a work report preserves that distinction.

actions.message: Please take account of the latest report of continued dripping and an apparently larger ceiling bulge beside the wet fitting in Flat 2. The stated attendance window is 12:30–13:15; please update the property manager on attendance and the on-site assessment. This is an update for the already arranged assessment, not authorization to expand work.

steps: Continue to keep the bedroom clear and keep people away from the wet fitting and ceiling; do not touch them or try an unfamiliar breaker.
If sparks, smoke, falling material, or immediate danger occurs, contact emergency services as previously advised and follow their direction.
